## Interfaces

- `dashboard/journal.py`: `JournalItem`, `load_journal`, `journal_scope`, `ordered`, `JournalScreen`, `RecordDetailScreen` — model from journal-model; screens from journal-screen.
- `EffortView.kind` / `journal_open` on snapshot (journal-model) consumed by `JournalPanel` on EffortPane (journal-panel).
- `task_detail.AgentWork` / `CollapsibleBlock` / `AgentWorkPanel` (journal-agent) independent of JournalScreen.
- `pager_command` reused by JournalScreen and Agent work `o`.
- Main `app.py` binds `J` and hosts JournalPanel; both wave-2 tasks edited it and landed together at 1eb4f7a.

## Assumptions

- Task-scoped journal records use task slug + `payload.effort`.
- Assignment `## Orientation` and amendment `## Correction` sections present for Agent work.
- Open rules reuse Needs you predicates (questions/findings).

## Invariants

- Only repair/evaluate pay for journal_open on main snapshot.
- Delivery main screen unchanged except JournalScreen key availability.
- Record text shown as stored; dashboard remains read-only.

## Conflicts

none — wave-2 concurrent app.py edits committed together; panel Enter uses RecordDetailScreen from journal-screen.
